name: Logo
purpose: Render the approved LegacyHQ brand mark, wordmark, or full lockup consistently across the product.
intent: Provide the single source for brand artwork so no surface recreates, recolors, or distorts the logo on its own.

figmaSource.note: Logo has no single Figma component node in the same sense as other primitives/atoms - it renders pre-exported SVG assets (packages/ui/src/assets/logos) directly via dangerouslySetInnerHTML, not a live Figma component instance. No node reference is recorded (checked alongside Icon, 2026-08-06); treat the checked-in SVG assets as the source of truth.

useCases: A compact nav rail or collapsed sidebar (type="mark")
antiPatterns: Stretching, cropping, rotating, or adding shadows/effects to the artwork
Recreating the wordmark in text instead of using the wordmark/full type
Combining with other graphics outside the mark/wordmark/full variants

anatomy.description: Renders the selected logo SVG asset directly; carries data-logo-type/data-logo-size.

title.description: Accessible name (and native tooltip via the title attribute); falls back to "LegacyHQ" when informative and no ariaLabel is given.

ariaLabel.description: Overrides the accessible name; takes precedence over title.

decorative.description: When true, aria-hidden with no role. When false (default), role=img with the accessible name.

className.description: Composes with the root's class list.

full.purpose: Mark + wordmark together - the primary lockup.

decorative.whenTrue: aria-hidden=true, no role - use when adjacent content already provides the same accessible name (e.g. a parent link with its own aria-label)
decorative.whenFalse: role=img with an accessible name from ariaLabel, then title, then "LegacyHQ"

requirements: Default is informative (decorative=false), unlike Icon - a logo is usually the accessible name for a link back to home.
Do not double up the accessible name - if the parent link already has aria-label, mark the Logo decorative.
Do not add roles beyond role=img.

behaviorRules: Render the SVG asset matching type as inline markup via dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
Apply data-logo-type and data-logo-size on the root.
Preserve the source SVG's aspect ratio - never stretch or crop.
compositionRules: Wrap Logo in an <a> when it functions as a home link; put the accessible label on whichever of the link or the Logo actually carries it, never both.
Do not combine Logo with other graphics outside the approved mark/wordmark/full variants.
responsiveRules: Prefer type="mark" in constrained navigation (mobile, collapsed sidebars).
Use type="full" where horizontal space allows, for maximum brand recognition.
themeRules: Must work in light and dark themes - the same SVG assets render correctly on either surface.
implementationNotes: Use React.memo for the exported component.
No recoloring, stretching, or effects applied via CSS beyond size.
SVG markup is escaped/injected via a small buildLogoSvg helper that sets the correct aria attributes per decorative state - do not bypass it to inject the SVG another way.
do: Use type="mark" in a compact nav rail.
Let Logo provide the accessible name when it's the only content in a link.
Pick the size token rather than scaling the rendered SVG with CSS transform.
dont: Recolor or restyle the rendered SVG.
Recreate the wordmark in a heading font instead of using type="wordmark"/"full".
Double up the accessible name between Logo and its parent link.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders the correct SVG asset for the selected type.
Supports all LogoType and LogoSize values.
decorative=false renders role=img with the correct accessible-name precedence (ariaLabel, then title, then "LegacyHQ").
decorative=true renders aria-hidden with no role.
Preserves aspect ratio at every size.
Works in light and dark themes.
Storybook includes Playground, a type x size Variants matrix, and realistic composition Examples.
knownLimitations: All five sizes are technically permitted for all three types - legibility of wordmark/full at xxs is a design judgment call, not enforced by the component.
futureEnhancements: A tokenized logo color strategy if the SVGs move to CSS-themeable currentColor fills
